simple.summary: עֵין־דֹּאר (ʻÊyn-Dôʼr) means En-Dor , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 28 7.

definitions.full: H5874. En -dor or En Dor or En-dor עֵיןדֹּֿר proper name, of a location in Manasseh Josh 17:11 (J E; omitted by ᵐ5 ), = ׳ע דּוֺר 1Sam 28:7 ( Αελδωρ , ᵐ5 L Αενδωρ ), דּֿאֹר׳ע Psa 83:11 (Gr ׳ע חֲרוֺד ), Αενδωρ ; Endûr, approximately 14 miles north-northeast from foregoing.
definitions.rootNote: or עֵין דּוֹר ; or עֵין־דֹּר ; from 5869 and 1755 ; fountain of dwelling ;
